text: Staggered Steps is an ability used by Pandaren Monk during a Pet Battle.
Stance of the Spirited Crane is a Mistweaver monk ability, available at level 10. It replaces Stance of the Fierce Tiger for Mistweaver Monks.
Stand Against the Legion is a Feats of Strength achievement rewarded for successfully completing a demon invasion during the Legion pre-launch world event.
Stained Pamphlet is given by Doomsayers in Orgrimmar and Stormwind City as a precursor of the Legion Invasion‎.

Stalwart Defenders are friendly warriors of several races that are at the Legion Invasion locations. Once saved, they can help the adventurers. They can only be saved by Alliance adventurers. They also appear in Highmountain during Legion Assaults.
Stag Blood Sample is obtained after selecting either of the two dialogue options available while interacting with the Docile Stag at the Magical Menagerie in Dalaran.

Stalriss Dawnrunner is a nightfallen leatherworker located in a cave named Den of the Demented in Felsoul Hold in Suramar. He was exiled from Suramar City by his colleagues, including Feorias. It is clear that he is in the process of withering, and it's affecting his concentration.

Stalwart Echoes are echoes of eredar soldiers located at Triumvirate's End in Eredath, forever remembering the day of the flight of the draenei. They defend their fellow Velen loyalists from the man'ari.
Stacks is a cook-o-tron located in Rustbolt on Mechagon Island. It was built by Smiles Cracklekey.
The Stair of Doom was a planned subzone in Shadowmoon Valley.
Staggered Stomps is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Stalker Sling is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Stage Hands are sylvar and faeries who assist with plays at the Star Lake Amphitheater in Ardenweald.

"Stay" is a pet command that tells the pet to remain where it is while the pet's master (a hunter or warlock) moves away. A defensive pet will still attack if something attacks it; and an aggressive pet will still aggro any mob that comes too close. The Stay command can be used by hunters to flee combat. This is done by ordering a pet with aggro on a mob to stay, then running until the pet is unsummoned; if done correctly the hunter be out of the mob's aggro range by the time the pet disappears. So long as the pet survives, it can be immediately resummoned with the Call Pet ability. Stay can be used in combination with Attack and Passive to temporarily clear a quest object or gatherable reso
__NOTOC__ Star Wood can be purchased for from Enchanting suppliers.
__NOTOC__ Star of Elune is a gem that is used in both Jewelcrafting and in Engineering, the gems fit . They are named after the goddess Elune.
The Star of Mystaria is a Level 42 Necklace that improves Intellect, Stamina, Critical Strike and Haste.
__NOTOC__ Starving Winter Wolves are frost wolves that can be found accompanying the Rare mob Timber on an island in Iceflow Lake in the dwarven starting zone of Dun Morogh.
__NOTOC__ Star Scryers can be found in Tempest Keep and The Eye.
Star's Lament is a PvP reward, and can be purchased for from: * in Hall of Legends * in Champions' Hall

Static Shock is a passive specialization ability for Enhancement shamans, available at level 40. It gives Stormstrike and Lava Lash a chance to deal damage equal to one charge of Lightning Shield without consuming an orb.
The Star-Beaded Clutch can be looted from the Gift of the Observer after defeating Algalon the Observer in the 25-man version of Ulduar.
Staying Buffed All Winter (10 player) is a dungeon & raids achievement earned for possess the effects of Toasty Fire, Storm Power and Starlight at the same time on 10-player mode.

State of Mind is a Tier 6 Holy priest talent introduced in patch 4.0.1 which reduces the cooldown of the Chakra talent ability by 3/6 seconds. Prior to patch 4.0.6, the talent allowed priests to extend the duration of their Chakra states by 2/4 sec upon successfully casting one of the corresponding spells. This allowed priests to remain within a Chakra state for extended periods of time without re-casting or losing the associated buff. With patch 4.0.6, the talent was changed to instead reduce the cooldown of the Chakra spell itself, so allowing priests to initiate a new Chakra state more quickly. However due to this change, it is no longer possible for priests to remain continuously within

Starwatch Tower is a small tower located on a cliff overlooking the ocean in southeast Uldum.. It's from here the expedition leader, Mekgineer Twizzleflux, who has gone insane from the "tomb curse" transforms more gnomes that arrive to aid the expedition.

The Starchaser is one of three blood elven destroyers used by the Sunreaver Onslaught to lay claim to the Isle of Thunder. Until the Horde claims Zeb'tula, she is anchored west of the Court of Bones in the Greymist Firth southwest of The Crimson Treader and Salabria, the other two ships. The ship leaves after The Assault on Zeb'tula is takes place.
Starry Spaulders of Durability are a possible drop from Ordos, the world boss yaungol on the Timeless Isle.

The stat squish (also known as the item squish or simply "the squish") saw many numbers within the game scaled down, including stats on items, player and mob health, and damaging and healing abilities. The first squish was implemented in Patch 6.0.2, and the latest squish (which was a level and stat squish) occurred in Patch 9.0.1. The "stat squish" strictly refers only to changes made to items, but in practice the term is often used to encompass three related changes, which in combination acted to drastically alter numbers in the game. Because these changes were implemented simultaneously, for many the sum total of the combined changes is viewed as the result of the stat squish. * Items fro
Star Root Tubers are obtained through interacting with tuber objects in the Gorian Falls in Ashran.
Star Root Sniffers are podlings found at the Gorian Falls in Ashran.

Starlight Rose is an herb introduced in Legion that can be found in Suramar as well as on the northern side of the Broken Shore. The flower's petals twinkle like the stars at night, hence its name. If not handled carefully, the flower dissipates into dust.
.]] Starweaver's Sanctum is a sanctum within the Moon Guard Stronghold of Suramar.

The Statue of Liftbrul is a statue of a legendary drogbar weightlifter located in Stonedark Grotto in Highmountain. The caption seems to be a transcription of an argument involving what to write for the caption. Damrul the Stronk tells players to carry a pair of weights to the statue and back during You Lift, Brul?.

Stay Salty is an achievement earned from defeating Lady Hatecoil in the Eye of Azshara after destroying 11 or more Saltsea Globules with a single Curse of the Witch in Eye of Azshara on Mythic Difficulty.
The Starcraft and Warcraft Coloring Book is a coloring book intended for children ages three and up. It features scenes from the StarCraft and Warcraft universes.
Starlight Thread can be extracted from Melandrus' Star-Touched Bracers.
The Star of Sha'naar was a quest reward from Assault on Mageddon.
The Stasis Core is an area near the Felfire Armory where powerful eredar are kept in stasis for later deployment, or to make them eredar brutes.
Statiks Quikfuse is a gnome standing next to Artificer Farud at the Stormwind Embassy in Stormwind City.

The Statues of Blizzard are sculptures of iconic characters, weapons or vehicles from Blizzard Entertainment's universes: Diablo, StarCraft, Overwatch, and Warcraft. BlizzCon visitors have a chance to see many of the statues when visiting the . Blizzard has also started offering smaller versions of the large scale statues as collectibles. Most statues were created by Steve Wang and later by the Alliance Studio. The most famous one of them must be the Orc Statue.
Stardust Archers are night elves located in Stonetalon Mountains.
Staying Power took place at Mist's Edge in Darkshore during the War of the Thorns.
Star-Stalker Treads drop from Kil'jaeden in the Tomb of Sargeras.

Stargazer Luna is a draenei who works for . Giving her the resources she needs, her field of work is astronomy, trying to figure out how to make the stars align. She shares her assistants with Zerek, Master Cloner, something he is not happy about.
The Star-touched Chest will appear in front of the Stellar Refraction Device in the Halls of Origination after the puzzle has been solved.

Star Topaz can be obtained from the following crowns that drop from Opulence in the Battle of Dazar'alor: *Crown of Bloody Succession *Crown of A'akul's Dark Reign *Crown of the Seducer *Electrified Crown of Rahu'ai

Stardust Crusaders is a dungeons & raids achievement earned by collecting 20 Motes of Titanic Power within 5 seconds and then defeating Argus the Unmaker in Antorus, the Burning Throne on Normal difficulty or higher.
Starving Glimmerflies are glimmerflies located at the Shimmering Pools in Bastion. During How to Catch a Glimmerfly, after collecting them, they become Revitalized Glimmerflies.
Star Lake Sonnets are looted from the Bounty of the Grove Wardens.

Star Lake Amphitheater is where the Night Fae put on stage shows for other fae and the Winter Queen, who has a reserved seat. Since the arrival of mortals, Dapperdew has been putting on plays featuring fights from the events of Legion and Battle for Azeroth, including: *Xavius *Gul'dan *Kil'jaeden *Argus *Jaina *Azshara *N'Zoth Members of the Night Fae Covenant may use their Tier One Anima Conductor to channel anima to Dreamsong Fenn, which will activate Dapperdew. Night Fae players can then speak with him to summon one of the rares. Defeat all seven to earn the achievement Ardenweald's a Stage. The world quest Tough Crowd takes place here. On the quest, boggarts have snuck into the audience

Starlit Overlook is an area of the dream tree of Tirna Rowen, located on a plateau above the Shrouded Mire. It is the highest point of all of Ardenweald, and the first part of the forest you see when you enter from Oribos. Lady Moonberry and Featherlight sent the adventurer from here to tell Droman Krelnor that his grove was to be culled.
Stars in a Jar are sold by the Toy Vendor in Tazavesh, the Veiled Market.
Star Burst is a Balance druid PvP talent, available at level 34. __NOTOC__
Star's Sorrow is sold by Nixi Fireclaw and Blazik Fireclaw in Dalaran for 12 Honor Points.
Starweaver is a Balance druid talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Rattle the Stars.

Stealth is a level 3 rogue ability that prevents other creatures from detecting the stealthed player unless particularly close. Attacking and most actions such as looting will cancel Stealth. Taking any damage will cancel Stealth, including direct, AoE and DoT damage, and environmental damage such as fires. However, Stealth does not break from falling damage, unless of course it kills the stealthed unit. You cannot enter Stealth while in combat.
Stegodons are large primitive dinosaurs native to Terror Run in Un'Goro Crater. They come in a variety of names, colors, and abilities, and all of them are elite.

This quest requires you to go down into the Ruins of Eldarath to find four tablets scattered randomly throughout the area. The quest can be completed at a low level if you are willing to die a few times. Upon completion of this quest, you will be given quests to deliver each tablet to a NPC in a major city and one in Azshara; these NPCs will send you back to the quest giver, granting you even more XP just for running around.

.]] .]] icon.]] Steamwarriors (a.k.a. steam warriors) are mechanics who take their skills to the battlefield by building walking suits of phlogiston-powered armor. Though the armor of most steamwarriors takes on a generally humanoid form, a suit's functions are as individualized as its pilot. The only activity most steamwarriors enjoy more than using their armor in combat is tinkering with it between battles, improving old functions and adding new ones. Some were born to steam, gifted with the measures of mechanics and systems, and possessed with an unquenchable thirst for invention. Among those inventors are individuals who push their creations to the limits of technology, testing them in b

Steelarrow Crossbow is an uncommon crossbow. It was tied with Ashjre'thul, Crossbow of Smiting for the slowest ranged weapon speed. Before ranged attack speeds were normalised, this was one of the most powerful weapons that a Hunter could use due to how ranged special attacks took advantage of weapon speeds.
The Steam Tonk Controller is a fun little device that lets you create a Steam Tonk, much like those found at the Darkmoon Faire.

Stefon the Loyal is a human paladin of the Order of the Silver Hand. He is a companion of Tagradin, Guzul'dar, and Lenaeas. Before the Third War, he was an unswerving servant to King Terenas Menethil II. But the tapestry of his life had unraveled when the threads of duty and honor were stripped away by a noble prince turned murderous monster, leaving Stefon to weave another from what remained: courage, strength of arms, and the conviction that he could make things right.
The Stealth Field Generator is provided as an objective for Profitability Scouting.

The steam winch is rapidly becoming a standard piece of traveling equipment for military units, merchant caravans and even small parties of adventurers. Its compact casing holds a small but powerful phlogiston engine that turns a drum wrapped with 300 feet of wirecore rope. Once bolted or spiked to a surface, the winch can be run in either direction to raise or lower up to 600 pounds. Upgraded steam winches are also available, featuring a drum of ironrope. This sturdier rope allows a load of 1,200 pounds.
__NOTOC__ Steeltoe McGee is a dwarf quest giver located in the Deep Reaches of Stonetalon Mountains.

The Steamwheedle Shyster is a goblin found in all major cities as well as Shattrath City and Dalaran. Talking to him allows players a small shortcut to queue up to fight Apothecary Hummel using the Dungeon Finder.
Stench is an ability used by various pets during a Pet Battle.
Steam Vent is an ability used by Jademist Dancer during a Pet Battle.
__NOTOC__ Stefan Frostbeard is a vrykul found at Oceanus Cove in Azsuna when Huge Cursed Queenfish (quest) is active.
__NOTOC__ Stelleris Libertines are nightborne located in Suramar City.
Steel-Reinforced Cage Helm drops from the Death Metal Knight during the Blight Boar concert every hour 30 minutes past the hour at the Darkmoon Faire.
Steelplated Hardshells are crabs located at the Heaps on Mechagon Island.
Steelarm Pillagers are Mechagon mechagnomes located west of Rustbolt on Mechagon Island. They steal parts from the Rustbolt Resistance and sell them to Bondo Bigblock's gang, the Pistonheads.
__NOTOC__ Stella Darkpaw is a worgen who can be encountered during Island Expeditions.

Steelsage Gao is a pandaren located on Mechagon Island. He traveled to the Dragon Isles where he can be found at the Obsidian Bulwark in the Waking Shores. He offers access to the Black Market Auction House.
__NOTOC__ Steelscale Volshasis is a saurok of the Slitherblade clan encountered in Island Expeditions.
Steelhoof Ancestors are Highmountain tauren ghosts summoned by Omanawkwa Steelhoof in the Halls of Valor.
Steel Singer Freza is a siren located in the Western Spray on Mechagon Island.
Steel-Plated Primate Exoskeleton is looted from Loose Parts after defeating Dookthar the Destroyer in Vol'dun during Faction Assaults. It is used to create the Rebuilt Gorilla Bot.
Steelwood Slab is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
The Steam-Powered Auctioneer would be created with Engineering.
Steelcore Wristwraps drop from Bloated Lootfly in Maldraxxus.
Steelcore Shoulders drop from Bloated Lootfly in Maldraxxus.
Steelcore Legguards drop from Bloated Lootfly in Maldraxxus.
Steelcore Gauntlets drop from Bloated Lootfly in Maldraxxus.
Steelcore Chestplate drops from Bloated Lootfly in Maldraxxus.

Stillwater Pond is a small lake located west of Brill in Tirisfal Glades. Before the Plague of Undeath, it was a popular site for picnics by the inhabitants of the glades, and the pond offered swimming opportunities for children who were not yet old enough to test their mettle in the much larger and deeper Brightwater Lake. Now the pond lies gray and forgotten, and only wandering undead and wild beasts set their eyes on its cold waters as they pass by. Only the still living skeletons of the lake's fish remain beneath the surface. The powerful darkhound Bayne roams around the pond, feasting on the unwary. After the Cataclysm, a thick fog hangs over the pond, which is now much bigger. A few ne

__NOTOC__ The Steward of Time is a bronze dragon found at the entrance of the Caverns of Time. He starts the quest To The Master's Lair. To players who have completed this optional quest (or the next step, The Caverns of Time), he instead offers a flight on dragonback to the central part of the Caverns.

Stillpine Hold is a small settlement on the northern side of Azuremyst Isle and home to the Stillpine tribe. The hold within the cave itself is occupied by corrupted and thus hostile moonkin, which the furbolgs wish to get rid of.
Sticky Spider Webbing is looted from Deepmoss Eggs in Stonetalon Mountains.
Steven Stutzka is a Forsaken flight master located at The Forsaken Front in Silverpine Forest.
__NOTOC__ Steven Lohan is a human innkeeper located behind the counter of the Blue Recluse in the Mage Quarter in Stormwind City.
Sticky Grenade is an ability used by some robots during a Pet Battle.
Sticky Web is an ability used by spiders and shale spiders during a Pet Battle.
Sticky Goo is an ability used by various pets during a Pet Battle.

Steven Lisbane is a master Pet Tamer located in Northern Stranglethorn. He is surrounded by his three level 9 battle pets: Nanners, Moonstalker and Emeralda. Bill Buckler is his longtime friend. Defeating him is required to complete the Taming Eastern Kingdoms achievement.
Still Water is a pet ability available exclusively to the water strider family of hunter pets.
Vark is a Stillpine ancestor who explains the fighting with the Stillpine and the Bristlelimb. The Totem of Vark is found on the western side of the island.
Stockade Guards are humans located at the Stormwind Stockade. Before the Cataclysm, they were located in the uninstanced part of the building in Stormwind City.
Stillwater Lilies are plants that grow along the shore of Stillwater Pond. They can be rendered into a broth more appealing to the palates of Undercity's Kor'kron Overseers.
Sticky Tarbomb is provided as an objective for Burn Them Down. It is used to destroy North Incubator Cage, South Incubator Cage, and West Incubator Cage in Agurak's Fall in Frostfire Ridge.
Stephen Wong is a pandaren cooking vendor located on the Shrine of Two Moons in Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
Stitch is a human boy living in Lakeshire in Redridge Mountains. He is a best friend of Aramar Thorne. They would sometimes play at the Lakeshire quarry. He and Willy collected dead spiders.
Stockade Archers were humans located in Stormwind City, protecting the exit of the Stormwind Stockade. After the Cataclysm, they were replaced by riflemen.
Stili the Salty is an ettin encountered by Class Order champions in Highmountain.
Steward Service Improvement: Harmonic Convergence would modify the Summon Steward ability.
Steward Service: Reagent Deposit would have modified the Summon Steward ability, allowing the steward to return Path of Ascension materials in the Reagent Bank.
Stinging Fiend is a ravager wasp located in Island Expeditions.
Stitched Harbinger's Greaves are a quest reward from Say The Magic Words, Fighting Words and The Last Word.
Stitched Wraith's Breeches are a quest reward from Say The Magic Words and Fighting Words.
Steward Argalos is a blue drakonid flight master located in Camp Antonidas in the Azure Span.
Stone Fury is a rare mob earth elemental found in the Alterac Mountains.
Stone Tomahawk is a quest reward from Rite of Strength (Classic).
Stone Behemoths could be found at Remtravel's Excavation in Darkshore prior to the Shattering.

Stoley is a human quest giver located at Steamwheedle Port in Tanaris. Like most residents of Steamwheedle Port, he has gone missing, and was possibly killed by the destructive wave that destroyed the port during the Cataclysm.

Stone Watcher of Norgannon appeared as a hologram when a player activated the Uldum Pedestal, which could be found in Tanaris. With the destruction of the gates of Uldum during the Cataclysm, it appears that the pedestal has been destroyed, and thus the Stone Watcher of Norgannon might never again be accessed.

The term stone giant refers to two or more different, yet possibly interconnected titan creations. All are, of course, giants made of stone. Stone giants were listed as one of the five types of titan-made giants, and so may be a single race that includes all other types of stone-based giants, such as mountain giants and colossi. In ancient times, they were led by the keepers to make war on the Old Gods and free Azeroth from their will.
* * These vendors are stationed at their faction's flight point in Wintergrasp, and only when their faction does NOT control the keep. They sell only the Arcanums and Inscriptions.
Stone Power Core is looted from War Reaver Parts after defeating War Reavers in the Ruins of Thaurissan in the Burning Steppes.
Stone Bulwark Totem is a talented shaman ability, available at level 15.
Stone Rush is an ability used by various pets during a Pet Battle.
Stone Shot is an ability used by various pets during a Pet Battle.
Stone Form is an ability used by various pets during a Pet Battle.

Stone Scales was a pet ability available exclusively to the basilisk family of hunter pets, reducing pet damage taken by 50%. It is functionally identical to the crab family's Harden Shell, the turtle family's Shell Shield, and the shale spider family's Solid Shell.
Stonebinder Agrogg is a drogbar located in Bitestone Enclave in Highmountain.
Stonebinder Gorgrogg is a drogbar located in Bitestone Enclave in Highmountain. He summons Plaguecloud Idols.
The Stoneblood are a group of harpies located in Val'sharah. They ravaged and claimed Wretched Hollow. They tried to use dark magic to turn Acolytes of Elo'thir to stone.
Stolen Power is a Demonology warlock artifact trait. It is linked to the Open Link trait.
The Stolen Royal Vendorbot is the gnomebot quartermaster of the Rustbolt Resistance located in Rustbolt on Mechagon Island.
Stolen Oil drops from Scrapbone Oilspewers and can be looted from the same-named objects in the Scrapbone Den on Mechagon Island.
Stolen Scrap Grenades are explosives located on Mechagon Island.
Stone Machinist Nu-Xin is a mogu of the Stonebound group encountered in the Unknown Crypt during Island Expeditions.

Stone fiends, referred to as Stoneborn Messengers, are small stoneborn gargoyles found in Revendreth made in the same manner as other stoneborn. They primarily serve as messengers for venthyr, with Temel having various and more important roles throughout Revendreth. Others are part of the Stone Legion or Darkwing. They keep track of famous venthyr they have encountered. The stone fiends also serve as flight masters for all of Revendreth, styled "Couriers".

Stone hounds are artificial hound-like beasts chiseled from stone and then magically infused with life. Two different races are classed as stone hounds: quilen (created by the mogu of Pandaria) and gargons (created by the venthyr of Revendreth).
Stone Prisons are located all over the Maw. They can be destroyed to free the Imprisoned Souls within.
Stone Teleporter Parts are contained in Relic Caches in Korthia.
Stone Legion Destroyers are stoneborn located at the Grand Palisade and Chalice District in Revendreth.
Stoneborn Allies are dormant stoneborn located in various areas in Revendreth. Upon awakening, they briefly appear in Pridefall Hamlet.
Stone Vanguards are earth elementals found in Ny'alotha, the Waking City.
Stone Encasements located in Zskera Vaults in the Forbidden Reach. They can be removed with Stone Dissolver, revealing any of the following: *Primordial Earth Cache *Shattered Crystals
Stone Spitter is a quest reward from Welcome to the City of Smells.

Stonesplinter Valley is a valley carved among the mountains in southwestern Loch Modan. Once a pristine setting, the valley is now crawling with hostile Stonesplinter troggs. Adventurers wishing to befriend the local dwarves will find plenty of work hunting the foul humanoids, and the most ambitious heroes strike deep into the heart of the valley in attempts to rid the region of the trogg leader, Grawmug.
Stoneguard Clayhoof was a tauren located in the Valley of Spirits in the orcish city of Orgrimmar.

__NOTOC__ The Stonemaul Ruins (previously known as Stonemaul Village) are the former home of the Stonemaul ogres. The original village was destroyed by members of Onyxia's brood. The ogre leader, Overlord Mok'Morokk led his people away from the ruin and established a new home to the north called Brackenwall Village. Brogg, the Stonemaul Survivor, unhappy with Mok'Morokk's inactivity with regard to seeking vengeance against Onyxia's brood, has set up camp in Mudsprocket and seeks assistance from adventurers in his quest. The ruins are located within Dragonmurk and are currently infested with Firemane Dragonspawn.

Stonebreaker Hold is a Horde town in central Terokkar Forest. There is a flightpath, innkeeper, and various quest giving NPCs. It has Mag'har architecture, including an old town hall and several watch towers.

Stonehearth Graveyard (abbreviated SH or SH GY) is the southernmost graveyard of Stormpike Guards in Alterac Valley. It is commonly one of the first objectives for the Horde in Alterac Valley. Horde forces can reach it via roads from Stonehearth Bunker or Stonehearth Outpost. The roads around this graveyard are patrolled by numerous alliance elites. Lieutenant Lonadin patrols the area north and northwest of the graveyard. Lieutenant Mancuso and Lieutenant Stouthandle patrol the roads south of the graveyard. In addition, Lieutenant Spencer guards the graveyard itself. Unlike the horde counterpart Iceblood Graveyard, these defenses are not crowded together. Horde forces often destroy Stonehear
Stoneshield Cloak is a Level 51 quality Cloak that improves Strength, Stamina and Parry.
Stonetalon Sap dropped from Sap Beasts in Stonetalon Mountains.
Stonebreaker's Totem can be purchased for from in Shattrath City.

The caverns of Stonetalon Peak located atop the Stonetalon Mountains were the caves that The Oracle, chapter 7 of the Warcraft III orc campaign, The Invasion of Kalimdor, took place in. The ancient Oracle lived here.
Stonetalon Ram Horns drop from Stonetalon Rams in the Stonetalon Mountains.

Stonetalon Pass is a small quest area where Horde players battle the Grimtotem. It is located to the northwest of Thunder Bluff in Mulgore. The path ends at a painted rock on a high plateau. However, intrepid explorers can fall to Boulderslide Ravine or Malaka'jin in Stonetalon Mountains if they head northeast (almost due east) from the top of the path. Walking along the rim of Mulgore can get one to the High Road, used by Horde players to travel between Stonetalon and the Southern Barrens while skirting the Alliance forces at Honor's Stand.
The Stonehearth Marshal guards Vanndar Stormpike in the fortress of Dun Baldar in Alterac Valley until Stonehearth Bunker is destroyed.
The Stonehearth Warmaster guarded Drek'Thar in Frostwolf Keep in Alterac Valley after the Stonehearth Bunker was destroyed.

The Stoneplow Fields surround Stoneplow in western Valley of the Four Winds. The Ik'thik mantid have breached the Serpent's Spine separating the valley from the Dread Wastes and have destroyed the western half of the fields. Members of the Shado-Pan have been called in to help. Many of the farmers live with their families in the fields, until they were evacuated into the town for their safety.
Stoneplow Envoys are pandaren located in the Forbidden Jungle in Krasarang Wilds. Upon being healed, they appear as Wounded Travellers in Shattered Convoy.
Stonebound Destroyers are terracotta warriors located in the Woods of the Lost in the Jade Forest.
Stonetalon Rams are rams found alongside the southern parts of the Webwinder Path in Stonetalon Mountains. __NOTOC__
Stoneskin is an ability used by battle pets during a Pet Battle.

Stonedark Grotto is a cave found in the Bloodhunt Highland of Highmountain. It is the home of the Stonedark tribe drogbar. Bogrogg the Stonescreamer in the Hall of Chieftains offers transport to the grotto.

The Stonedark tribe (or Stonedark clan) is a relatively peaceful tribe of drogbar who live in the Stonedark Grotto in Highmountain, isolated from their more violent kin who live further south under the rule of Dargrul the Underking. They are led by Navarrogg.

Stonecrown Cavern is a large cave south of the Ironhorn Enclave on Highmountain Peak. It appears to be a drogbar cave, but currently serves no purpose and does not even have creatures in it. All music comes to a stop while inside.
Stoneshroom is a consumable sold by the Mushroom Merchant in Neltharion's Lair. On use, it reduces your damage taken for 1 minute. It is only usable in Highmountain.

The Stonefin is a tribe of murlocs found on the Broken Shore. They lived peacefully on the island until the Burning Legion arrive. Now, the demons are enslaving the tribe and renamed themselves to Felfin.
Stonefist Brawlers are drogbar located in the Darkbrul Arena in Highmountain.
Stonefist Pit Guard is a drogbar located in Deep Roads in Highmountain.
The Stonefist are a group of drogbar inhabiting Highmountain. They are PvA fighting team led by Brick, known as Brick's Bruls.
Stonedark Focus drops from the following members of the Bloodtotem tribe in Highmountain: *Feltotem Bloodbinder *Feltotem Bloodsinger *Feltotem Bonehound *Feltotem Demonkindre *Feltotem Warmonger
__NOTOC__ Stonetalon Warders are night elves located in the Stonetalon Mountains.
Stonedark Drinking Buddy is a drogbar summoned by Drinking Buddy in Highmountain.
Stonedark Fishbruls are drogbar located in Thunder Totem in Highmountain.
Stonedark Reinforcements are drogbar located in Highmountain.
Stonetalon Sentinels are night elves located in Stonetalon Mountains.
Stonetalon Grunts are orcs located in Stonetalon Mountains. After the Cataclysm, they also fight the night elf forces in northern Stonetalon. These are seen wielding crossbows.
Stonehide Elderhorn is a rare moose mount drop from Island Expeditions.

This quest is a two part quest. First is the gazebo and the second is killing. To explore the gazebo you need to run into it and stand in the glowing light. After that, even prior, you need to kill the 12 mobs listed in the quest. The gazebo is located on the island in the middle of Mystral Lake.
Stonehorn the Charger is a stag located in Island Expeditions.
Stonejaw the Rock-Eater is a trogg located in Skittering Hollow during Island Expeditions.
Stoneflesh Figurine is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Stonepiercer Signet is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.

in the background.]] Stonewatch Falls is located on the terminus of Lake Everstill's eastern river. It cascades down the hill below Stonewatch and forms a deep lake in the nook of the eastern Redridge Mountains. A small tribe of murlocs make their home here, catching fish from the lake and erecting crude structures to sleep in.

Stonewatch is the common name of the military stronghold in central Redridge Mountains. This human fortress serves as a defensive base against the orcish raids coming from the nearby Burning Steppes. It includes both the easily defensible Stonewatch Keep and the armored Stonewatch Tower, with the Stonewatch Falls cascading down a cliff face below it.

The Stonewrought Pass is a tunnel in Searing Gorge that leads northeast to Loch Modan. The pass is located at the northern end of Dustfire Valley, and ends at the Valley of Kings. Franclorn Forgewright designed this, as well as the Stonewrought Dam and other stonework architecture in the Eastern Kingdoms. Before the Cataclysm, the pass was surrounded by locked gates on both sides. Mountaineer Pebblebitty guarded Loch Modan gate, only letting Alliance players through after a small quest chain initiated by killing Margol the Rager. Since then, however, the pass is permanently open on both sides.

Storm Shadowhoof is a tauren quest giver located in Everlook in Winterspring. Unlike all other NPCs in Everlook save the wind rider flight master, he was marked as hostile (but not aggressive) towards Alliance until patch 2.3. He was originally found in Bloodvenom Falls. He has been missing since the Cataclysm. His current whereabouts and status are completely unknown.
Stormer Ewan Wildwing is a Wildhammer dwarf quest giver located at the Deathforge Tower in Shadowmoon Valley.

Stormcrest Eagles are a special breed of giant eagle. They are snowy eagles that are rather large, much larger than the rest of the eagles in Azeroth. These majestic beasts are incredibly resilient and are able to withstand the harsh landscapes of their home, Storm Peaks. Due to this, they are the flying mount of choice for the Frostborn, who have also been able to overcome the rugged and unforgiving terrain of the Storm Peaks and make it their home. Similarly to the Wildhammer dwarves and their loyal gryphons, the Frost dwarves share a bond with these eagles that is unshakable. The Frostborn breed their hatchlings near Frosthold.
Storm the Beach was a player vs. player achievement earned for breaking down the walls, destroying the relic chamber door, and right-clicking the Titan Relic in under 4 minutes.

Storm's Fury Wreckage is a crashed Horde gunship located in the middle shelf of Deepholm, southeast of Temple of Earth. The earth elementals are slowly clearing out the wreckage. The gunship was captained by Captain Skullshatter and carried a fragment of the World Pillar towards the Temple of Earth. As they were approaching the temple, they were shot down by Llane's Oath, an Alliance gunship that had been infiltrated by the Twilight's Hammer. Storm's Fury Wreckage ground.jpg
Stormer Heart drops from Cliff Stormer in the Stonetalon Mountains.
Stormfeather Outpost is a Wildhammer outpost in the Hinterlands established after the Cataclysm. It has an inn, flight master, and quests for Alliance players.

The Stormbridge is the main crosswalk leading from the Ruined Approach to the Grand Courtyard and Thunder King's fortress. When the heroes attempt to cross this bridge, Lei Shen greets them on the other side and destroys the walkway to prevent the heroes from crossing and sending them into the Lair of Tortos.

Storm Elemental is an Elemental shaman talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Fire Elemental (shaman ability).
Stormcall was a teleport spell that enabled shaman to travel from their current location to the Heart of Azeroth and back. It was a quest reward from A Ring Reforged.

The Stormcoil are a group of naga who recently invaded the northeastern coast of Vol'dun on orders from Queen Azshara to search for the :Ring of Tides, a powerful artifact that was lost there during a battle between a naga army and the loa Kimbul centuries ago. Led by Overseer Zarjish, the Stormcoil attacked Darkwood Shoal, killing many of the Tortaka tortollans who lived there and forcing the rest to flee to Tortaka Refuge. After uncovering the Stormcoil's goals with the help of an adventurer, the Tortaka turn to Kimbul at his temple for help. Stormpeak Wyrms are proto-dragons found on the Foot Steppes in the Storm Peaks. The iron dwarves captured Veranus, the brood mother of the proto-drakes. The drakes have now gotten very aggressive. They have pushed into stormcrest territory and the eagles have taken to an all-out fight with them. They can be seen at times grabbing rhinos and flying off with them.

Stormshield Stronghold is the Alliance base within the PvP zone of Ashran. Found to the south of the main island, Stormshield Stronghold acts as the base of Alliance operations within the PvP zone, featuring a graveyard, vendors and the zone's Alliance Generals. It serves as a rally point for Alliance players to turn in Artifact Fragments, seek repairs and purchase battlefield upgrades and new gear. Heavily-defended, it is nevertheless under constant threat from the Horde, who seek to invade from the north. To the south of Stormshield Stronghold lies Stormshield itself, Alliance capital on . The Horde equivalent is Warspear Outpost, found at the north of Ashran.

Stormshield is the main Alliance base on , found on the south end of the island of Ashran. Set just outside the main PvP zone, Stormshield is protected by Stormshield Stronghold, the Alliance's main keep within Ashran proper. Stormshield was presumably abandoned after the war in Draenor as its inhabitants returned to Azeroth. The Horde equivalent is Warspear, found at the north end of Ashran.
